name: GDP per inhabitant in PPS
definition: Gross domestic product per inhabitant in purchasing power standards, which take out the differences in price levels between countries, as a share of the EU average.

name: GDP per inhabitant
definition: Gross domestic product per inhabitant in euros at current prices, without adjusting for the differences in price levels between countries.

name: Real GDP growth
definition: Growth of the gross domestic product in volume, without the effect of inflation, on the previous year.

name: Price level of GDP
definition: How expensive the goods and services of the whole economy are compared with the EU average: above 100 dearer, below cheaper.

name: Exports of goods and services
definition: The value of the goods and services sold abroad, as a share of GDP.

name: Investment (gross fixed capital formation)
definition: Spending on fixed assets, such as buildings, machinery and software, by businesses, government and households, as a share of GDP.

name: Research and development expenditure
definition: Gross domestic expenditure on research and development by all sectors, as a share of GDP.

name: Government gross debt
definition: Consolidated gross debt of general government at the end of the year, as defined in the Maastricht Treaty.

name: Government deficit (-) or surplus (+)
definition: Net lending (+) or net borrowing (-) of general government: how much more it took in than it spent, or less.

name: Taxes and social contributions
definition: Receipts from taxes and net social contributions of general government and the EU institutions, as a share of GDP.

name: Government expenditure
definition: Total expenditure of general government, as a share of GDP.

name: Inflation (HICP)
definition: Change of the harmonised index of consumer prices, all items, average of the year on the average of the previous year.

name: House price index
definition: Prices of all the dwellings bought by households, new and existing, as an index with 2015 = 100, average of the year.

name: Net earnings of a single worker
definition: Annual net earnings of a single person without children earning the average wage, after income tax and social security contributions.

name: Gender pay gap
unit: % of men's average gross hourly earnings
definition: The difference between the average gross hourly earnings of men and of women, as a share of men's, in industry, construction and services except public administration.

name: Unemployment rate
definition: Unemployed people aged 15 to 74 as a share of the labour force, the people who work or look for work.

name: Youth unemployment rate
unit: % of the labour force aged 15 to 24
definition: Unemployed people aged 15 to 24 as a share of the labour force of that age.

name: Long-term unemployment rate
definition: People aged 15 to 74 unemployed for 12 months or more, as a share of the labour force.

name: Employment rate
definition: Employed people aged 20 to 64 as a share of the population of that age.

name: Gender employment gap
definition: The employment rate of men aged 20 to 64 minus that of women.

name: Part-time employment
definition: People aged 15 to 64 working part-time, as a share of all the employed people of that age.

name: Young people neither in employment nor in education or training
definition: 15 to 29 year olds who are not employed and not in formal or non-formal education or training (NEET).

name: At risk of poverty or social exclusion
definition: People at risk of poverty, severely materially and socially deprived, or living in a household with very low work intensity.

name: At-risk-of-poverty rate
definition: People whose disposable income, after social transfers and adjusted for the size of the household, is below 60% of the national median.

name: Median equivalised net income
definition: The income that splits the population into two halves: the disposable income of each household divided by its number of equivalent adults.

name: Income inequality (Gini coefficient)
definition: Gini coefficient of equivalised disposable income: 0 when everybody has the same income, 100 when one person has all of it.

name: Income quintile share ratio (S80/S20)
definition: The income of the richest 20% of the population divided by that of the poorest 20%.

name: Severe material and social deprivation
definition: People who cannot afford at least 7 of 13 items that most people consider necessary for an adequate life, such as keeping the home warm or facing an unexpected expense.

name: Housing cost overburden rate
definition: People living in a household that spends more than 40% of its disposable income on housing.

name: Overcrowding rate
definition: People living in a dwelling without enough rooms for the size and make-up of the household.

name: Population
definition: The number of people living in the country on 1 January.

name: Population growth
definition: The change of the population over the year, from births, deaths and migration, per 1,000 inhabitants.

name: Birth rate
definition: The live births of the year per 1,000 inhabitants.

name: Fertility rate
definition: The number of children a woman would have if the birth rates of each age in the year stayed the same throughout her life; about 2.1 keeps a population stable without migration.

name: Net migration
definition: People who moved into the country minus those who moved out, per 1,000 inhabitants, with the statistical adjustments of Eurostat.

name: Median age
definition: The age that splits the population into two halves, the younger and the older.

name: Old-age dependency ratio
unit: People aged 65 and over per 100 aged 15 to 64
definition: The number of people aged 65 and over for every 100 people of working age, 15 to 64.

name: Life expectancy at birth
definition: The number of years a newborn would live if the death rates of the year stayed the same throughout their life.

name: Healthy life years at birth
definition: The number of years a newborn would live without a long-lasting limitation in usual activities, at the death rates and the health of the year.

name: Infant mortality rate
definition: Deaths of children under one year of age per 1,000 live births.

name: Health expenditure
definition: Current spending on health care by all payers, public and private, as a share of GDP.

name: Early leavers from education and training
definition: 18 to 24 year olds with at most lower secondary education who are not in education or training.

name: Tertiary education attainment
definition: 25 to 34 year olds who completed tertiary education: a university degree or a short higher education course.

name: Adult participation in learning
definition: 25 to 64 year olds who took part in education or training in the last four weeks.

name: Daily internet use
definition: People aged 16 to 74 who use the internet every day or almost every day.

name: Online shopping
definition: People aged 16 to 74 who bought goods or services online in the last 12 months, from 2020, when Eurostat changed the survey.

name: Renewable energy
definition: The share of the energy used that comes from renewable sources.

name: Energy import dependency
definition: Net imports of energy as a share of the energy available; negative for a country that exports more energy than it imports.

name: Net greenhouse gas emissions per inhabitant
definition: Net emissions of greenhouse gases, including those taken up or given off by land use and forests, per inhabitant.

name: Municipal waste
definition: Waste collected from households, and similar waste from businesses, per inhabitant.

name: Recycling rate of municipal waste
definition: The share of municipal waste that is recycled, composting included.

name: Passenger cars
definition: The passenger cars registered per 1,000 inhabitants.

name: Intentional homicide
definition: Offences of intentional homicide recorded by the police, per 100,000 inhabitants.

name: GDP per inhabitant in PPS
definition: Gross domestic product per inhabitant of the region in purchasing power standards, as a share of the EU average.

name: Research and development expenditure
definition: Gross domestic expenditure on research and development in the region by all sectors, as a share of the region's GDP.

name: Unemployment rate
definition: Unemployed people aged 15 to 74 as a share of the labour force of the region.

name: Employment rate
definition: Employed people aged 20 to 64 as a share of the population of that age in the region.

name: At risk of poverty or social exclusion
definition: People of the region at risk of poverty, severely materially and socially deprived, or living in a household with very low work intensity.

name: Population growth
definition: The change of the population of the region over the year, from births, deaths and migration, per 1,000 inhabitants.

name: Population density
definition: The number of people living in the region per square kilometre of land.

name: Life expectancy at birth
definition: The number of years a newborn in the region would live if the death rates of the year stayed the same throughout their life.

name: Tertiary education attainment
definition: 25 to 64 year olds of the region who completed tertiary education.
